table_description:
# Basic VPW Example Table
This table is meant to be a starting point. It implements VPW physics and Fleep sounds. More detailed scripts and resources can be found within the main VPW Example table.

This table includes a playfield image that shows a standard Stern lower third layout. 

Copy and paste the walls, primitives, ramps, and targets on the left side of the table as needed.

*NOTE!* You must include all new rubber posts in the dPosts collection, and all new rubber sleeves in the dSleeves collection. Also, include the other walls in their respective Fleep collections (Rubbers, Metals, Walls, etc) if you want their mechanical sound effects to work.
